related_questions.question: How to apply for a Kenya visa from the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: To apply for a Kenya visa from the USA, you need to apply for an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) online through the official eTA website. The eTA is now the standard entry requirement for Kenya, replacing the previous visa system. You will need to create an account on the eCitizen platform, then apply for the eTA, providing necessary personal and travel information, and pay the required fee. Once approved, you will receive your eTA via email, which you must print out and present at the Kenyan border.
snippet_highlighted_words: apply for an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) online through the official eTA website

list.snippet: Access the official eTA website: Go to the official Kenya eTA website.
Register or Log in: If you don't have an account, register as a visitor on the eCitizen platform. If you already have an account, log in.

Navigate to the eTA application: Select "Department of Immigration services" and then "Submit Application". Choose "Kenyan Visa" and select the type of visa needed (usually a single-entry or transit visa).
Complete the application form: Fill in all required fields accurately, including personal information, passport details, and travel details.
Pay the application fee: Use a debit or credit card to pay the processing fee.
Submit your application: Review all information for accuracy and submit the application.
Await approval: The approval process can take a few days, so apply well in advance of your travel dates.
Receive and print your eTA: Once approved, you will receive your eTA via email. Print it out and keep it with you for presentation at the Kenyan border.
Present your eTA at the border: Show the printed eTA to the immigration officer at the port of entry.

list.title: No visas on arrival:
list.snippet: Kenya no longer issues visas at the border; all travelers must have an approved eTA before departure.

list.title: Processing times:
list.snippet: It's recommended to apply for the eTA at least 3 days before your intended travel date, according to some sources, but it's best to apply earlier to allow for any potential delays.

list.title: Fees:
list.snippet: The eTA fee is typically around $30 USD, but additional fees may apply if using a visa service or requesting expedited processing.

list.title: Eligibility:
list.snippet: Ensure you meet the eligibility requirements for the eTA, including having a valid passport with sufficient validity, a valid email address, and a passport-sized photo.

related_questions.question: How much is a visa to Kenya from the USA?

text_blocks.snippet: For most travelers, including U.S. citizens, Kenya now requires an Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA) instead of a traditional visa. The eTA costs $34.09, which includes a $32.50 government fee and a $1.59 bank fee. You can apply for the eTA online through Kenya's official eTA website.

list.snippet: eTA Cost: $34.09 (including government and bank fees).
Application: You'll need to apply online through the official eTA portal.
Required Documents: A valid passport (valid for at least six months beyond your arrival date), a passport-style photo, contact information, and travel itinerary.
Processing Time: It's recommended to apply at least three days before travel, but you can apply up to three months in advance.
Validity: The eTA is valid for a single entry and allows for a stay of up to 90 days.
